</mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="149" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Pipeline for citing article summarization</h1><div>This process takes the scoping review as a set of seed documents and searches for citing works from OpenAlex. Citing works will continually change, unlike the seed dataset which is a snapshot of past works. Citing works will change each year as new documents are published. Creating a corpus of new works, the summarization module will take just the key points from each new work and create a summary dataset. The Chat interface can then be used to query this summarized dataset for finding relevant documents and understanding their content.&nbsp;</div>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="116"> <mxGeometry x="50" width="550" height="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
This notebook used NLTK to tokenize and index all text files.
1. takes the title, abstract, keyword, from each txt file to create a corpus, and takes the url to create a url corpus
2. saves out the corpus and the url as lists, which are further saved as .pkl files for later import
3. tokenize using "e"n stopwords and creates the BM25 model (indexing)
4. saves out retriever/model as 'lns_bm25'- this is a folder containing many files.

div.div: This process takes the scoping review as a set of seed documents and searches for citing works from OpenAlex. Citing works will continually change, unlike the seed dataset which is a snapshot of past works. Citing works will change each year as new documents are published. Creating a corpus of new works, the summarization module will take just the key points from each new work and create a summary dataset. The Chat interface can then be used to query this summarized dataset for finding relevant documents and understanding their content.
